Links lists this host's links to entries on other hosts, each checked
with its host over the bus, and says which have gone stale (--dangling
lists only those), with what to run:

  out of step   one entry is closed and the other still open
  one-sided     the other host has no link back
  not found     the other host has no such entry, or a different one
                under that id now
  unreachable   the other host didn't answer; shows what was last seen

Usage:
  agent friction links [flags]

Examples:
  agent friction links
  agent friction links --dangling

Flags:
      --dangling   Only links that are out of step, one-sided, not found, or unreachable
  -h, --help       help for links
      --json       Print as JSON

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
